headline: Australia Central Bank Hikes Rates to Highest Level Since 2008
summary: Australia's central bank hiked its key interest rate to an 18-year high on Tuesday, citing the prolonged war in the Middle East and elevated inflation.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions directly influence borrowing costs, economic activity, and currency valuations within the country.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Higher interest rates increase borrowing costs across the Australian economy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The interest rate hike to an 18-year high directly impacts domestic yields and monetary conditions in response to inflation and geopolitical pressures.
